about: Line counts of the hand-written global stylesheets; read by tools/check_css_budget.py. A file may shrink but not grow: new styling goes in Tailwind utilities or a component's scoped styles, with token roles. Lower a number with --update; raising one needs --allow-growth and a reason, recorded under growth.

exempt.dashboard/src/app.css: Tailwind's names for the theme's roles; it gains a line when a role does.
exempt.dashboard/src/theme/tokens.css: The theme's roles themselves; theme.test.ts keeps unused ones out.
